name: fleet
description: Run a Claude Code agent turn on another machine in a personal fleet, over SSH on the tailnet. Every machine signs into its own Claude account, so the built-in peer tools are same-account and never span machines; this carries the SSH path that does, with target resolution from the rendered fleet manifest, one-shot and multi-turn headless recipes, the Windows-side relay that reaches a target's own sessions, and the permission posture that keeps remote agent launches prompting.
